calls.title: Betr + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Better discussed its experimentation strategy, emphasizing the need to align UX improvements with core business metrics such as revenue and player engagement. The team, led by Alex Ursa, highlighted their aim to focus on impactful, larger experiments annually rather than continuous minor tests. They rely on BigQuery as a central data warehouse to capture user financial and behavioral data in real-time, which enhances cohort-level analysis. The introduction of GrowthBook was considered advantageous due to its seed pricing model, BigQuery integration, and user assignment capabilities, addressing previous concerns with tools like Firebase. A cautious rollout plan was established, involving a small cross-functional team to validate the platform with a few major tests per year.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, BigQuery, audience segmentation, sticky bucketing, event forwarding, React Native integration
